papers.title: Thermal expansion coefficients in Invar processed by selective laser melting
papers.abstract: This work investigates whether the unique low thermal expansion property of Invar (64Fe–36Ni) is retained after processing using the additive manufacturing process selective laser melting (SLM). Using this process, near-full-density components (99.96%) were formed by melting thin (20 μm) layers of powdered Invar (15–45 μm particle size). The mechanical properties of SLM Invar were comparable to that of cold-drawn Invar36®; however, the thermal coefficient of expansion was observed to be a lower value and negative up until 100 °C. This negative value was attributed to residual stress in the as-deposited parts. The low thermal expansion property of Invar was still maintained when processed using a non-conventional layer-based additive manufacturing technique.

summary_en.motivation: Investigate whether the low thermal expansion property of Invar (64Fe–36Ni) is retained after selective laser melting (SLM) processing.
summary_en.method: Near-full-density (99.96%) Invar components were fabricated by SLM and characterized for thermal expansion and mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: SLM Invar exhibited a lower and negative coefficient of thermal expansion up to 100°C, attributed to residual stress.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were compared to cold-drawn Invar36®.

papers.title: On the Breakdown of SiC during the Selective Laser Melting of Aluminum Matrix Composites
papers.abstract: Selective laser melting (SLM) is used to produce a SiC reinforced aluminum metal matrix composite (AMMC, Al–12Si plus 10 vol% SiC) with laser energy densities ( ) between 20 and 80 J mm −3 . Microstructural analysis shows that at lower energies, SiC is present in the Al–12Si matrix; however, at higher energies there is a distinct lack of SiC particles and the extensive formation of Al 4 C 3 needles and primary Si particles. XRD analysis confirms a decrease in the volume of SiC and an increase in the amount of Al 4 C 3 and primary Si with increasing . This indicates that a reaction occurs between the Al and SiC during SLM. The underlying mechanism is attributed to the selective absorption of laser energy into the SiC particles, causing regions of extremely high temperatures. The formation of the reaction products cause errors in the theoretical density calculations. Therefore, X‐ray micro tomography (XMT) is used to independently measure the relative density of the samples with a peak relative density ≈97.4%, which is much higher than that (relative density ≈93%) measured using the Archimedes method.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是铝合金基复合材料的激光选区熔化工艺，不涉及生物医用植入物或骨整合，与用户方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on material reactions in Al-SiC composites during SLM, with no biomedical context, no porous implant design, no mechanical testing relevant to stress shielding or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SiC增强铝基复合材料在SLM过程中的分解机制。
summary_zh.method: 不同激光能量密度下制备Al-12Si+10%SiC复合材料，用XRD和XMT分析。
summary_zh.result: 高能量密度导致SiC分解生成Al4C3和初晶Si，XMT密度测量更准确。
summary_zh.validation: XRD物相分析、XMT密度测量与Archimedes法对比。

summary_en.motivation: Investigate the decomposition mechanism of SiC reinforcement during selective laser melting of aluminum matrix composites.
summary_en.method: Al-12Si + 10 vol% SiC composites were processed by SLM at varying laser energy densities and characterized by XRD and X-ray microtomography.
summary_en.result: Higher energy densities caused SiC decomposition into Al4C3 needles and primary Si, and XMT provided more accurate density measurements than Archimedes method.
summary_en.validation: Phase identification via XRD and density comparison between XMT and Archimedes method.

papers.title: Dual-Mobility vs Fixed-Bearing Total Hip Arthroplasty in Patients Under 55 Years of Age: A Single-Institution, Matched-Cohort Analysis
papers.first_author_affiliation: Division of Adult Reconstruction and Joint Replacement Surgery, Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Hospital for Special Surgery, New York, New York

corresponding_authors.name: Geoffrey H. Westrich
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Division of Adult Reconstruction and Joint Replacement Surgery, Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Hospital for Special Surgery, New York, New York

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是临床结果对比研究，未涉及生物力学建模或应力遮挡分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it is a clinical outcomes comparison without biomechanical modeling or FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较双活动与固定平台在全髋置换中的临床结果。
summary_zh.method: 单中心匹配队列分析，比较翻修率和脱位率。
summary_zh.result: 双活动组脱位率更低，但翻修率无显著差异。

summary_en.motivation: To compare clinical outcomes of dual-mobility versus fixed-bearing total hip arthroplasty in young patients.
summary_en.method: A single-institution, matched-cohort analysis compared revision and dislocation rates between the two bearing types.
summary_en.result: Dual-mobility bearings showed significantly lower dislocation rates but no difference in revision rates.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up data from a single institution.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Zhoukou Normal University, Zhouko, 466000, Henan, People’s Republic of China

papers.venue: Journal of Materials Engineering and Performance

llm.relevance_to_user: 虽涉及LPBF制造CoCrMo合金，但未包含多孔结构、应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合分析。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; focuses only on dense part quality.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM工艺参数对CoCrMo合金零件质量的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过改变激光功率和扫描速度制造试样，测试密度、硬度及耐磨性。
summary_zh.result: 优化参数可获得高致密度、高硬度和良好耐磨性的零件。
summary_zh.validation: 密度和硬度测试与文献对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of SLM process parameters on the quality and performance of CoCrMo alloy parts.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated under varying laser power and scanning speed, followed by density, microhardness, and wear resistance measurements.
summary_en.result: Optimized parameters yielded parts with high density, microhardness, and wear resistance suitable for biomedical applications.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through density measurements, cross-sectional microhardness testing, and wear rate evaluation.
